method: CMS identity match plus claim-level review of provider-owned location pages
releaseRule: A record may advance only when identity, location, contact, population, services, hours, access, and routing coordinates are resolved. Missing evidence is never inferred.

records.name: Chandler Regional Medical Center
records.sourceNotice: CommonSpirit states that each location submits its directory information and recommends calling to verify accuracy.
records.statusReason: Clinical and access evidence resolved; independent routing coordinates remain unresolved.

identity.evidence: Official page names the Emergency Room at Chandler Regional Medical Center.

location.evidence: 1955 W Frye Rd, Chandler, AZ 85224 matches CMS CCN 030036.

population.evidence: Provider states patients of all ages and staff trained in adult and pediatric emergency medicine.

services.evidence: Emergency care, Level I trauma, MRI, CT, laboratory, specialty coverage, and mental-health emergencies are explicitly listed.

hours.evidence: Emergency care is explicitly available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

access.evidence: Provider states emergency care is available without insurance or ability to pay; financial assistance may be available.

routing.evidence: Exact address is known, but independently checked coordinates have not yet been stored.
